compareDisposition.rationale: No distinct two-source pairing adds more than this passage and its existing Scripture connections.

observations.body: Peter makes his movement conditional on a command from Jesus.
observations.label: Request

observations.body: Wind, fear, sinking, a cry, an extended hand, and a question fill the distance between boat and return.
observations.label: Attention

observations.body: The wind ceases after both enter, and those in the boat respond together.
observations.label: Boat

payload.posture: Follow command, movement, perception, cry, rescue, question, and return without turning one moment into the whole scene.
payload.tension: Peter acts on the command and then becomes afraid while still on the same path toward Jesus.
payload.title: Out of the boat
